note: KDWP state fishing lake northeast of Manhattan, in a 179-acre wildlife refuge of riparian timber. Primitive camping only in the designated sites on the west side, short gravel spurs in the trees along the southwest shore by the south vault toilet. Boat ramp and north toilet on the north shore; 12 piers, 42 picnic tables around the lake. Boating for fishing only, no swimming, no alcohol; fires in the metal rings only. --Claude
